segment_contamination_dimensions: Non-FRP material security cabins (MS, GI, wooden, PVC, aluminium, PUF) — buyers searching material-specific alternatives are served by sibling MCATs (MS Security Cabins, GRP Cabin, Wooden Guard Room, PVC Portable Cabin, PUF Cabin) and must not be attracted by FRP-specific names

General-purpose or office-use portable cabins (Office Cabin, Prefabricated Cabin, Modular Portable Cabin, Mobile Cabins) — buyers seeking workspace or multi-person accommodation are a different buyer persona from security/guard-post buyers; names must not use office, workspace, accommodation, or multi-room framing

Specialised booth types with dedicated MCATs (Toll Booth, Frisking Booth, Telephone Booths, Portable ATM Cabin, Smoking Cabin) — these are distinct buyer intents; names must not claim toll, frisking, ATM, telephone, or smoking contexts

Broad material-agnostic security cabin MCATs (Security Cabins ID 42755, Portable Security Cabins ID 135705, Prefabricated Security Cabin ID 181975) — these are sibling MCATs whose names are blocked from exact or semantic reuse; all enhanced names and alt names have been verified to not match these sibling names
